name: Side Cut Metropark
ownership: Metroparks Toledo / Metropolitan Park District of the Toledo Area
description: Side Cut is where the Metroparks system began more than 90 years ago, and remains a signature Toledo-area destination today. The riverside park draws fishermen from around the country as walleye swim upriver to spawn in the rapids in late March and April. The name 'Side Cut' is derived from the former 'side cut' extension of the Miami and Erie Canal that connected the main line of the canal with the city of Maumee. Three of the six original locks from the canal system were preserved by WPA workers during The Great Depression.

name: Camp Miakonda

description: Camp Miakonda at the DeVilbiss Scout Reservation is a 160 acres resident-type facility for Scouting groups. The DeVilbiss Scout Reservation is the 5th oldest Scouting America camp in the United States. Fourteen rustic cabins are available for rental. Four Adirondack sites (3-sided buildings), tent camping sites, a pool, a lake, chapel, dining hall (with food service operation), Trading Post, Historical Museum, a marked historical trail, and Fort Scheib are also on-premises. The Council Lodge, Ford Center, and Wildlife Center are available for day, evening, or weekend use for special events, dinners, training seminars, etc. for both Scout and non-Scout groups. Ohio's oldest and America's 5th oldest surviving Scout camp.
